After 23 years of marriage, you run out of ways to say "I love you" that actually feel new. 🥺

I was so tired of buying the same expensive jewelry that just sits in a box, or writing the same message in a $5 greeting card. I wanted to give her something that proved I haven't just been here—I've been paying attention to every single second.

I found Timeless Song and sent them our story. I told them about the gas station where we first locked eyes. I told them about our honeymoon in the Whistler mountains. I told them about the day she carried our twins.

I was honestly a little nervous it might sound like a cheap, cheesy jingle. But when I got the file back and pressed play? I was completely floored. It is a breathtaking, radio-quality masterpiece. It sounds like a hit record you'd hear on the drive home.

I set up my camera, told her I found a song she might like, and watched her face. When she heard her own name in the lyrics... she completely broke down. 😭❤️

Some feelings are just too big for a card and too deep for words. This song said everything I’ve always wanted to say but didn't know how.

If you want to give the most meaningful gift of your life to the person who stayed through it all, this is it. They even have a 30-day money-back guarantee, so there is zero risk. Best decision I've ever made.
